newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Golkar party just short of majority.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Golkar party just short of majority.

text.p: Indonesia's ruling Golkar party was just short of reaching an absolute majority in general elections, according to the latest returns on Friday.
Election officials said that by 5 a.m. (2200 GMT Thursday) Golkar had won over 58.6 million of the 78.93 million votes counted, or about 74.34 percent.
Its nearest rival, the Moslem-oriented United Development Party, had won 18.04 million votes, or about 22.85 percent.
The third party in the contest, the Indonesian Democratic party, was trailing with 2.21 million votes, or 2.81 percent, the officials said.
Nearly 125 million people were eligible to vote in Thursday's polls but there was no immediate word on how many ballots were cast.
